title: Power Rankings: Early unbeatens on the rise
heading: 2010-11 Power Rankings: Week 1
author: Marc Stein

rankings.summaryHtml: Anyone (besides Phil) still worried about Kobe after he shot 28 percent from the floor in the preseason? Anyone else surprised to learn that Kobe's Lakers have won a league-leading six straight road openers?
